description: If the finite context \(\Gamma\) together with \(A\) derives \(C\) and \(\Gamma\) together with \(\neg A\) derives \(C\), then \(\Gamma\) derives \(C\).

  (hA : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives (insert A Γ) C)
  (hnotA : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives (insert A.neg Γ) C) : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives Γ C
